page: Microsoft Azure E248s_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Esv7 family. It features 248 dedicated virtual CPUs powered by Intel processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 1888.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.61 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, relying instead on its Premium Storage capability for remote disk attachments. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. These specifications present a tradeoff where workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space or hardware-accelerated graphics must look to other instance families, while memory-intensive applications benefit from the large, dedicated RAM allocation.

Given the high memory density and large vCPU count, the E248s_v7 is structured for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing tasks. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of 248 dedicated vCPUs and 1888.0 GB of RAM consolidates massive workloads onto a single virtual machine, reducing multi-instance management overhead.
